ruleDefinitions.name: History File Deletion
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects events in which a history file gets deleted, e.g. the ~/bash_history to remove traces of malicious activity

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/rm$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/unlink$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/shred$")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/\\\.bash\\_history.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/\\\.zsh\\_history.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\_history$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.history$") OR process_command_line = RGX("zhistory$"))))
